blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Financial institutions operate under dense, frequently amended rulebooks, and answering a compliance question correctly requires not only fluency but verifiable grounding in the authoritative text. Large language models are attractive for this task, yet the models that firms can realistically deploy on-premise are compact ones, and compact models hallucinate obligations. We study whether a carefully domain-adapted retrieval-augmented generation pipeline closes that gap. Our retriever is built in three stages on top of LegalBERT: entailment tuning that recasts question–passage matching as premise–hypothesis reconstruction, contrastive tuning with in-batch negatives, and score-level fusion with BM25. Our generator is a compact model (2B–12B parameters) served under 4-bit quantization, either prompted or adapted with retrieval-aware fine-tuning (RAFT) through LoRA. On ObliQA, a question-answering benchmark built from the Abu Dhabi Global Market rulebooks, the staged retriever raises Recall@10 from 0.256 to 0.774 and outperforms BM25 (0.678) and E5-large-v2 (0.758), the strongest general-purpose dense encoder we tested.
RAFT-LoRA then improves the composite RePASs answer-quality score for every model we could adapt, with the largest gain on the weakest one. However, the adapted models do not transfer to Australian case-law questions, and a closed-book model that receives no passages at all scores within 0.011 RePASs of the full pipeline while producing answers that cite nothing and misstate obligations. The retrieval gain is therefore measured directly, the generation gain is a gain in RePASs rather than demonstrated grounding, and grounding itself requires an evaluation protocol that RePASs does not provide.
blocks.zh:
金融机构在密集的、经常修正的规则手册下运作,如要正确回答遵守问题,不仅需要流利,而且需要在权威性案文中加以可核查的基础。 大型语言模型对这项任务很有吸引力,但公司可以实际部署的模型是紧凑的模型,而紧凑的模型则产生幻觉。 我们研究一个经过仔细的域调整的检索-增强生成管道是否弥补了这一缺口。 我们的检索器是在LegalBERT之上分三个阶段建造的:将问题重铸的内置调子 — — 作为前提的通道匹配 — — 假说重建、与内置底片的对比调子和与BM25的分数级融合。 我们的生成器是一个紧凑的模型(2B-12B参数),在4位的量化下服务,通过LORA进行催化或调整后进行检索-感知微调。 在ObliQA上,由阿布扎比全球市场规则书构建的问答基准,舞台检索器将Recall@10从0.256提升至0.774,并超越BM25(0.678)和E5-大V2(0.758),是我们测试过的最强的通用密集编码器.
RAFT-LORA随后改进了组合 RePAS的答题质量分数,为每一个我们能适应的模型,其中最弱者获得的最大收益. 然而,经过调整的模型不会转至澳大利亚的判例法问题,而是一种封闭式的书本模型,在完整的编审中,在0.011 RePAS的分数内,没有获得任何段落,而只得出一字不提和错误陈述义务的答案。 因此,检索收益是直接计量的,生成收益是再评价制度的一种收益,而不是显示基础,而地面本身则需要再评价制度没有提供的评价协议。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Regulated financial companies operate inside a body of rules that is large, cross-referential, and in constant flux [ 1 ] . A single question is typically answered by locating a handful of facts scattered across chapters and reconciling them. These financial companies currently do this through specialist staff and commercial research tools, which makes compliance slow and, when a provision is missed, expensive [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 受监管的金融公司在一套大型、跨优惠和常年流动的规则中运作。 一个问题一般通过查找分散在各章的少数事实并加以调和得到回答。 这些金融公司目前通过专门人员和商业研究工具来完成这项工作,这使履约速度缓慢,而且在错过一项规定时费用昂贵[2、3、4]。

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are an obvious candidate for automating parts of this workflow [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] . Used out of the box, however, they are a poor fit. Without access to the source text, an LLM has to rely on what it memorized during training, and its recall of specific rulebook clauses is unreliable: it may paraphrase provisions that do not exist or omit binding conditions, and it sounds equally confident in both cases [ 9 ] . In compliance work this is particularly problematic, because such an answer cannot be traced to any provision and therefore cannot be checked.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)是本工作流程部分自动化[5,6,7,8]的明显候选. 但是,从盒子里拿出来的,它们很不合适。 无法获取源文本,LLM必须依赖其在培训期间所记住的内容,它召回具体的规则手册条款是不可靠的:它可能诠释不存在的条款或省略约束性条件,在这两种情况下听起来都具有同等的信心[9]. 在履约工作中,这一点尤其成问题,因为这种答复不能追溯到任何规定,因此无法加以核查。

blocks.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) [ 10 ] addresses this problem by retrieving relevant passages from an authoritative corpus and supplying them as context, so that answers can be traced back to the source text. The quality of a RAG system, however, depends heavily on its retriever. Provisions in different chapters of a rulebook often use nearly identical wording while differing in scope, applicability, or exemptions. Lexical overlap is therefore a weak relevance signal, and general-purpose dense encoders trained on web data are not designed to tell which of two similar clauses applies to a given case [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 检索获得的生成(RAG)[10]通过检索权威文献的相关段落并将其作为上下文提供来解决这一问题,从而可以追溯到源文本. 然而,RAG系统的质量在很大程度上取决于其检索器。 规则书不同章节中的规定往往使用几乎相同的措词,但范围、适用性或豁免不同。 因此,表征重叠是一个薄弱的相关性信号,在网络数据方面受过培训的通用密集编码器并不是用来说明两个类似条款中哪一个适用于特定案例[11].

blocks.en: A second constraint is a more practical one. Regulatory documents and the questions asked about them are often confidential, so many institutions cannot send queries to a hosted frontier model and have to run models on their own hardware [ 12 ] . In practice, this limits the choice to quantized models with up to roughly 12B parameters (depending on the budget of the firm of course), which have the least legal knowledge and the weakest grounding behavior. Improvements therefore have to come from the pipeline around the model rather than from model scale.
blocks.zh: 第二个制约因素是更为实际的。 监管文件及所问问题往往保密,因此许多机构无法向托管的前沿模型发送查询,不得不在自己的硬件上运行模型[12]. 在实践中,这限制了以大约12B个参数(当然取决于公司的预算)对模型进行量化的选择,而这些模型的法律知识最少,最薄弱。 因此,改进必须来自模型周围的管道,而不是模型规模。

blocks.en: In this paper, we investigate how far such a pipeline can be improved. We build a RAG system for regulatory question answering in which both halves, the retrieval and the generation, are domain-adapted, and we evaluate it on ObliQA [ 13 ] , a benchmark derived from the rulebooks of the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) and on Open Australian LegalQA [ 14 ] as an out-of-domain control. Our contributions are:
blocks.zh: 在这份文件中,我们调查这种管道可以改进到什么程度。 我们构建了一个监管问题答案的RAG系统,在这个系统中,一半的检索和生成都经过了域的调整,我们在ObliQA[13]上评价它,这是从阿布扎比全球市场(ADGM)的规则书和开放澳大利亚法律QA[14]上得出的一个基准,作为域外控制. 我们的贡献是:

blocks.en: • A three-stage retriever that starts from LegalBERT [ 15 ] and applies entailment tuning, contrastive tuning, and linear score fusion with BM25. Each stage helps, and the composition lifts Recall@10 on ObliQA from 0.256 to 0.774, past BM25 (0.678) and past E5-large-v2 (0.758) despite using a far smaller encoder. • A leakage-free re-split of ObliQA. The published splits share source documents across train, validation, and test; we rebuild them at document level and quantify what this costs in dataset size. • A controlled comparison of prompting against retrieval-aware fine-tuning for five compact generators. Prompting effects are model-dependent and often negative, whereas RAFT-LoRA improves the composite RePASs score for all three models we could adapt stably, most for the weakest one. • Two negative results. Adapters trained on ADGM rulebook data do not transfer to Australian case law, and a closed-book model without access to any passage scores within 0.011 RePASs of the full retrieval pipeline, even though its answers are not grounded. We attribute the latter to a weakness of the metric and discuss what this means for evaluating regulatory QA systems.
blocks.zh: • 一个从LegalBERT[15]开始的三阶段检索器,并采用前置调制、对比调制和与BM25的线性分数聚变。 每个阶段都有所帮助,其成分将ObliQA上的Recall@10从0.256升至0.774,过去是BM25(0.678)和过去是E5大v2(0.758),尽管使用的编码器要小得多. • ObliQA的无渗漏重排。 公布的拆分在列车、验证和测试中共享源文件;我们在文件一级重建这些文件,并量化数据集大小的成本。 • 支助 对照五台紧凑发电机的检索-感知微调进行有控比较。 快速效应依赖模型,而且往往是负面的,而RAFT-LORA则改进了所有三种模型的复合RPAS分数,我们可以稳定地调整,大多数适用于最弱者。 两个负面的结果。 接受ADGM规则手册数据培训的适配器不会转移到澳大利亚的案例法中,而且一个封闭的书籍模型在完全检索管道的0.011 RePAS中没有任何通过分数,尽管其答案没有根据。 我们把后者归咎于衡量标准的一个弱点,并讨论这对评价监管质量保证制度意味着什么。

blocks.en: A three-stage retriever that starts from LegalBERT [ 15 ] and applies entailment tuning, contrastive tuning, and linear score fusion with BM25. Each stage helps, and the composition lifts Recall@10 on ObliQA from 0.256 to 0.774, past BM25 (0.678) and past E5-large-v2 (0.758) despite using a far smaller encoder.
blocks.zh: 一个从LegalBERT[15]开始的三级检索器,并应用内含调和,对比调和,和与BM25的线性分数聚变. 每个阶段都有所帮助,其成分将ObliQA上的Recall@10从0.256升至0.774,过去是BM25(0.678)和过去是E5大v2(0.758),尽管使用的编码器要小得多.

blocks.en: A leakage-free re-split of ObliQA. The published splits share source documents across train, validation, and test; we rebuild them at document level and quantify what this costs in dataset size.
blocks.zh: ObliQA的无渗漏重排. 公布的拆分在列车、验证和测试中共享源文件;我们在文件一级重建这些文件,并量化数据集大小的成本。

blocks.en: A controlled comparison of prompting against retrieval-aware fine-tuning for five compact generators. Prompting effects are model-dependent and often negative, whereas RAFT-LoRA improves the composite RePASs score for all three models we could adapt stably, most for the weakest one.
blocks.zh: 对照五台紧凑发电机的检索-感知微调进行有控比较。 迅速效应依赖模型,而且往往是负面的,而RAFT-LORA则改进了所有三种模型的复合RPAS分数,我们可以稳定地调整,最弱者最多。

blocks.en: Two negative results. Adapters trained on ADGM rulebook data do not transfer to Australian case law, and a closed-book model without access to any passage scores within 0.011 RePASs of the full retrieval pipeline, even though its answers are not grounded. We attribute the latter to a weakness of the metric and discuss what this means for evaluating regulatory QA systems.
blocks.zh: 两个负面的结果。 接受ADGM规则手册数据培训的适配器不会转移到澳大利亚的案例法中,而且一个封闭的书籍模型在完全检索管道的0.011 RePAS中没有任何通过分数,尽管其答案没有根据。 我们把后者归咎于衡量标准的一个弱点,并讨论这对评价监管质量保证制度意味着什么。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Regulatory and Legal Question Answering
blocks.zh: 2.1 法规和法律问题回答

blocks.en: Regulatory NLP applies language technology to statutes, rulebooks, and compliance guidance, where texts are long, heavily structured, and full of normative operators (obligations, permissions, prohibitions) whose scope is set by conditions and exceptions [ 16 ] . Answering questions over them is closer to multi-passage aggregation than to span extraction, since the governing conditions for one obligation are routinely stated elsewhere.
blocks.zh: 规范NLP将语言技术应用到法规,规则书和合规指导中,文本长,结构严密,并充满规范操作者(义务,权限,禁令),其范围由条件和例外规定[16]. 回答关于它们的问题更接近于多通道的汇总,而不是跨度抽取,因为一项义务的管辖条件通常在其他地方说明。

blocks.en: Progress in this area has been driven by datasets. CUAD [ 17 ] annotates contract clauses for review tasks; LexGLUE [ 18 ] assembles legal understanding benchmarks; FinQA [ 19 ] targets numerical reasoning over financial filings. Closest to our setting is ObliQA [ 13 ] , which pairs questions with the ADGM provisions that answer them and introduces RePASs, an obligation-aware answer metric; that work also defines the retrieve-then-generate task formulation we adopt. [ 20 ] treat regulatory compliance as document-to-document retrieval over European legislation, and [ 21 ] study synthetic data for the same domain. [ 22 ] generate question–answer pairs from German statutes and adapt LLMs with parameter-efficient fine-tuning, reporting gains over unadapted baselines. That strategy is close in spirit to the fine-tuning half of our pipeline, though it is applied to a different jurisdiction and without a retrieval-aware objective. Earlier legal QA systems relied on rules and keyword matching [ 23 , 24 , 25 ] , later on neural judgment and retrieval models [ 26 , 27 , 28 ] . A broader and more detailed survey of LLM use in finance is given in [ 29 ] .
blocks.zh: 这一领域的进展是由数据集推动的。 CUAD[17]为审查任务注释合同条款;LexGLUE[18]汇编了法律理解基准;FinQA[19]针对的是财务申报的数字推理。 与我们的背景最接近的是ObliQA[13],它把问题与回答这些问题的ADGM条款联系起来,并引入了RePAS,这是一个了解义务的答案的衡量标准;这项工作还定义了我们采用的检索-再生成任务公式。 [20] 将监管遵守情况视为对欧洲立法的文件对文件的检索,[21]研究同一领域的合成数据。 [22] 从德国法规中生成问答对,并调整LLMs,使其具有参数效率的微调,报告相对于未调整基线的收益. 这项战略的精神接近于微调我们一半的管道,尽管它适用于不同的管辖区,没有意识到回收目标。 早期的法律QA系统依赖规则和关键词匹配[23,24,25],后来依赖神经判断和检索模型[26,27,28]. [29] 提供了范围更广、更详尽的关于融资中LLM使用情况的调查。

blocks.en: 2.2 Sparse, Dense, and Hybrid Retrieval
blocks.zh: 2.2 Sparse、Dense和混合检索

blocks.en: BM25 [ 30 ] remains a strong baseline wherever terminology is fixed, which describes regulatory text well, but it cannot bridge paraphrase. Dense retrieval [ 31 ] embeds queries and passages into a shared space and handles paraphrase, and general-purpose encoders such as E5 [ 32 ] and BGE [ 33 ] transfer well across many domains. Specifically domain-pretrained encoders such as LegalBERT [ 15 ] know legal vocabulary but, as we confirm in Section 4.2 , are not good retrievers out of the box: masked-language pretraining optimizes token prediction, not the geometry of a similarity space.
blocks.zh: BM25[30]在术语固定的地方仍然是一个强有力的基线,它很好地描述了规范文本,但它不能弥合解释。 Dense retrievation [31] 将查询和通道嵌入一个共享空间并处理解说,以及E5[32]和BGE[33]等通用编码器在很多领域都进行了很好的传输. 具体地说,如LegalBERT[15]之类的域前编码器知道法律词汇,但是,正如我们在第4.2节所证实的那样,它们并不是一个好的检索器:蒙面语前训练优化了符号预测,而不是相似空间的几何学.

blocks.en: Two lines of work address this limitation. Contrastive training with in-batch negatives and a multiple-negatives ranking loss [ 34 , 35 , 36 ] can reshape the embedding space directly. Entailment tuning [ 37 ] instead reformulates retrieval as an inference task: a passage is relevant if it entails a claim derived from the question, which is a better match for legal text where two passages can be topically identical yet only one legally supports the answer. Combining sparse and dense scores recovers the strengths of both [ 38 , 39 ] . Our retriever composes all three ideas in sequence rather than choosing among them.
blocks.zh: 有两条工作线处理这一限制。 与插座负数和多负数排名损失[34,35,36]的对比训练可以直接重塑嵌入空间. 细节调整[37]转而将检索重拟为一项推论任务:如果某一段涉及从问题中产生的权利要求,则该段具有相关性,这与法律文本更为吻合,因为两段在专题上可以完全相同,但只有一段在法律上支持答案。 将稀疏和稠密的分数结合起来,就能恢复[38,39]的长处. 我们的检索员按顺序排列所有三个想法,而不是在它们之间作出选择。

blocks.en: 2.3 Retrieval-Augmented Generation
blocks.zh: 2.3 检索增强的一代

blocks.en: RAG [ 10 , 40 ] conditions generation on retrieved evidence, reducing hallucination and making answers attributable [ 41 , 42 ] . Extensions target its failure modes: Self-RAG [ 43 ] adds self-critique, Robust-RAG [ 44 ] defends against corrupted contexts, and RQ-RAG [ 45 ] refines ambiguous queries. RAFT [ 46 ] takes a different route and trains the generator itself to read a retrieved context: each training instance mixes an oracle passage with distractors, and for a fraction of instances withholds the oracle entirely, so the model learns to use evidence when present and to abstain from inventing it when absent. We adopt RAFT because it specifically targets hallucinations caused by irrelevant retrieved passages, which a high-recall retriever over regulatory text will inevitably return.
blocks.zh: RAG[10,40]在检索到的证据上创造条件,减少幻觉,并给出可归因于此的答案[41,42]. 扩展以失败模式为目标:自我RAG [43] 添加了自我critic,Robust-RAG [44] 防御腐败背景,RQ-RAG [45] 完善了模棱两可的询问. RAFT [46] 选择了不同的路线,并训练生成器自己读取一个检索到的上下文:每个训练实例会将一个甲骨文通道与分散器混合,对于一小部分情况则完全扣留甲骨文,因此模型在出现时会学会使用证据,缺席时不会发明. 我们采用RAFT是因为它专门针对不相关的检索段落造成的幻觉,一个高调的检索者对监管文本的回顾将不可避免地返回.

blocks.en: 2.4 Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: 2.4 参数-有效微调

blocks.en: Full fine-tuning of a 7B model requires considerably more GPU memory than many compliance teams likely have available. Adapter modules [ 47 ] and LoRA [ 48 ] , which learns a low-rank update to frozen attention projections, reduce the trainable parameter count by orders of magnitude, and QLoRA [ 49 ] adds 4-bit quantization of the frozen base so that a 7B model can be adapted on a single commodity GPU. Refinements continue in this direction [ 50 , 51 ] . We use QLoRA throughout, which allows us to run all RAFT experiments on a single GPU and matches the on-premise setting described in the Introduction section.
blocks.zh: 全面微调7B模型需要GPU内存比许多可能的合规团队要多得多. 适配器模块[47]和LORA[48],它们学习低级更新以进行冷冻注意力预测,通过数量级来减少可列车参数的计数,QLORA[49]增加了4位的冷冻基数,这样就可以在一个单一商品GPU上调整一个7B模型. 朝此方向不断完善[50,51]. 我们一直使用QLORA,这使我们能够在单一的GPU上运行所有的RAFT实验,并与导言部分描述的现场设置相匹配.

blocks.en: 2.5 Positioning of this work
blocks.zh: 2.5 这项工作的位置

blocks.en: Each component of our pipeline is established: domain-pretrained legal encoders [ 15 ] , entailment tuning [ 37 ] , contrastive tuning with in-batch negatives [ 34 ] , sparse–dense fusion [ 39 ] , and retrieval-aware fine-tuning [ 46 ] . We claim none of them as new.
blocks.zh: 我们管道的每一个组成部分都已经建立:域前法编码器 [15], 包含调制 [37], 对比式调制与插件负式调制 [34], 稀疏的调制 [39], 以及 reface-aware 微调 [46]. 我们声称这些都不是新的。

blocks.en: What is new is their composition into a single pipeline for financial-regulatory QA under an on-premise compute budget, together with a controlled evaluation of that pipeline: a staged retriever ablation on a leakage-free re-split, a like-for-like comparison of prompting against RAFT-LoRA across five compact generators, a transfer test of the resulting adapters to a different legal genre, and a closed-book control that isolates how much of the measured answer quality is attributable to retrieval at all. LLeQA [ 52 ] fixes a retrieve-then-read setup and varies the reader. CBR-RAG [ 53 ] varies the retrieval representation for a fixed generator. CLERC [ 54 ] reports retrieval and generation separately but with off-the-shelf retrievers. LegalBench-RAG [ 55 ] isolates retrieval rigorously while stopping short of generation. We instead vary both halves over a single shared retrieval run, and add a closed-book control, so that the contribution of each stage, and the point at which the metric stops tracking grounding, are separately identifiable.
blocks.zh: 新的是,它们组成一个单一的金融监管质量保证管道,根据精确的计算预算,同时对该管道进行控制性评价:对无渗漏的再分层进行分阶段回收器减速,对五个紧凑发电机对RAFT-LORA进行类似的比较,对产生的适配器进行转录测试,将其转录到不同的法律流派,以及采用封闭式账簿控制,将所测量的答案质量有多少可归因于检索。 LLeQA [52] 修正一个检索和阅读的设置,并改变读者. CBR-RAG [53] 改变固定生成器的检索表示. CLERC [54] 报告检索和生成,但与现成检索器分开。 Legal Bench-RAG [55] 严格隔离检索,同时停止短产. 相反,我们既通过一个共享的检索运行将数据减半,又增加了一个封闭的账簿控制,这样,每个阶段的贡献,以及度量停止跟踪地面的位置,都可以单独识别。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Task and Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.1 任务和管道

blocks.en: Let 𝒫 \mathcal{P} be a corpus of regulatory passages and q q a natural-language compliance question. The system must return an answer a a that is entailed by 𝒫 \mathcal{P} and that covers the obligations 𝒫 \mathcal{P} imposes on the situation in q q . blocks.en: 3.2 Leakage-Free Data Construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 无渗漏数据建设

blocks.en: A precondition for every result below is that no passage seen at evaluation time was used in training. ObliQA does not satisfy this. It ships with predefined splits, but the sets of source documents behind them intersect: | D train ∩ D eval | > 0 |D_{\text{train}}\cap D_{\text{eval}}|>0 for every pair. Because ObliQA questions are generated from passages, a model that has seen one question from a document has effectively seen the passage that answers a different question from the same document. This is passage-level train–test leakage, and it inflates retrieval scores in particular, since the gold passage is then an item the encoder was optimised on rather than an unseen target. We therefore re-split at document level, which excludes this form of leakage by construction.
blocks.zh: 以下每项结果的先决条件是,在培训中没有使用评价时看到的任何段落。 ObliQA不满足这一点。 它的船身带有预先定义的拆分,但后面的一组源文件相交: | D列车 ∩ D val | | > > 0 D _{\ text{train }}\ Cap D_{\ text{ e 0 每对. 因为Obli 质检问题来自段落,从文件中看到一个问题的模式,有效地看到了回答与同一文件不同问题的段落。 这是通过水平的列车测试渗漏,它特别夸大了检索分数,因为黄金通道是当时编码器被优化而不是隐蔽的目标。 因此,我们在文件一级重新划分,排除了这种建筑渗漏的形式。

blocks.en: We therefore pool all questions and re-split at document level. The 40 ADGM documents are shuffled under a fixed seed and assigned 80%, 15%, and 5% to train, validation, and test, respectively. Single-passage questions follow their document. Multi-passage questions are admitted only if all of their passages land in the same split, and are otherwise discarded. This removes 989 question–passage pairs, which we consider an acceptable trade-off for a leakage-free evaluation. All numbers in this paper are computed on these re-split sets and are therefore not directly comparable to published ObliQA results measured on the original splits. Table 1 shows the resulting splits. Corpus construction is independent of the split: all 40 documents contribute their 13,705 passages, keyed by documentID-passageID .

blocks.en: 3.6 Generation with Prompting

blocks.en: The first generator variant conditions a frozen instruction-tuned model on ( q , P k ) (q,P_{k}) . All models receive an identical system instruction, namely to act as a regulatory compliance assistant and synthesize every obligation in the supplied passages into one coherent answer, under three strategies: zero-shot; few-shot with three worked examples, one of which demonstrates the correct response to a question the context does not answer; and few-shot with chain-of-thought [ 56 , 57 , 58 ] , adding explicit reasoning instructions and constraints while still emitting only the final answer. Decoding is greedy with a 512-token budget.

blocks.en: Two properties of this setup should be stated explicitly. The targets A i ∗ A_{i}^{*} are teacher outputs from GPT-4o-mini rather than human-written gold answers, so what the adapted models learns is the teacher’s answer behaviour, namely exhaustive enumeration of the obligations present in the supplied passages and explicit abstention when they are absent, over contexts that our own retriever produced. The RAFT training sets are also deliberately small, at 150 to 200 instances per corpus or under 1% of the available training questions. We therefore present this as an efficient adaptation recipe, one teacher pass and a few hundred optimisation steps on a single GPU, and not as evidence that the resulting behaviour is independent of the teacher model or of how the training contexts were assembled.

blocks.en: 3.8 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.8 评价

blocks.en: Retrieval is measured by Recall@10, MRR@10, and nDCG@10 against the annotated gold passages.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en: All experiments run on single NVIDIA T4, L4, or A100 GPUs, with A100s reserved for generation and LoRA training. Generators are loaded in 4-bit NF4 quantization via bitsandbytes , so every model in Table 5 fits on one commodity accelerator. We evaluate five compact instruction-tuned models: Qwen2.5-7B [ 60 ] , Teuken-7B v0.6 [ 61 ] , Gemma-2-2B [ 62 ] , Gemma-3-12B [ 63 ] , and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B [ 64 ] .
blocks.zh: 所有实验都运行在单NVIDIA T4,L4或A100 GPU上,A100为生成和LORA训练预留. 发电机通过比特和字节进行4位NF4的量化,所以表5中的每一个模型都适合一个商品加速器. 我们评价了五个紧凑的指令调制模型:Quen2.5-7B [60],Teuken-7B v0.6 [61],Gemma-2-2B [62],Gemma-3-12B [63],以及DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B [64].

blocks.en: All reported numbers are computed on the validation split of each corpus; the two-document ObliQA test split is held out and untouched. Retrieval is evaluated exhaustively against the complete corpora, on 3,733 ObliQA question–passage pairs drawn from 3,191 questions and on 427 Australian queries. Generation is evaluated on a fixed sample of 150 validation questions per configuration, held constant across models and strategies; the sample is a concession to the cost of scoring long-form answers with two NLI models, and we return to it in Section 4.6 .
blocks.zh: 所有报告的数字都按每个实体的验证分数计算;两份文件的ObliQA测试分数保持不动。 检索会针对完整的公司、3,733 ObliQA问题(从3,191个问题抽取的对)和427个澳大利亚问题进行详尽的评估。 每个配置的150个验证问题的固定样本对生成情况进行评价,在模型和战略之间保持不变;样本是两种NLI模型评分长式答案成本的减让,我们在第4.6节中回到这个问题。

blocks.zh: 4.2 检索

blocks.en: “Off-the-shelf” LegalBERT performs poorly as a retriever: it ranks the gold passage among the top ten for only one in four ObliQA queries and one in five Australian queries. Therefore, Domain-specific pretraining alone does not yield an embedding space suitable for retrieval.
blocks.zh: “现成的”LegalBERT作为检索者的表现不佳:它将黄金通道排在前十名,在ObliQA的4个查询中只有1个,在澳大利亚的5个查询中只有1个。 因此,仅针对域的预训并不能产生适合检索的嵌入空间.

blocks.en: Entailment tuning roughly doubles every ObliQA metric (Recall@10 0.256 → 0.495 0.256\rightarrow 0.495 ) and has a far larger effect on Australian case law ( 0.190 → 0.726 0.190\rightarrow 0.726 ). We attribute this difference to the question types. Australian questions name a case or instrument and ask what it provides, so a single passage decisively entails the answer and the premise–hypothesis objective aligns almost perfectly with the task. ADGM questions ask what a class of regulated entity must do, and several provisions bear on that, so entailment alone leaves ambiguity.
blocks.zh: 尾端调音大约是每双倍 ObliQA 度量衡(召回@10 0.256 → 0.495 0.256\ 右侧0.495),对澳大利亚判例法的影响更大(0.190 → 0.726 0.190\ 右侧) 页:1 我们将此差异归因于问题类型。 澳洲人问起一个案例或工具, 问它提供了什么, ADGM问题问,受管制实体必须做什么,一些条款对此有影响,因此,仅涉及问题就留下了模糊之处。

blocks.en: Contrastive tuning is the larger step on ObliQA ( 0.495 → 0.732 0.495\rightarrow 0.732 ) and consolidates the Australian gain ( 0.726 → 0.911 0.726\rightarrow 0.911 ). We attribute this to the model learning to distinguish between passages with similar regulatory vocabulary, which is the main difficulty in ObliQA. BM25 fusion adds a final + 0.042 +0.042 on ObliQA and + 0.012 +0.012 on Australian data, with a disproportionate effect on ranking quality: on ObliQA, Recall@10 rises 5.7% relative while MRR@10 rises 14.7%, i.e. BM25 mostly promotes passages the dense model had already retrieved but ranked too low. That is the expected signature of exact-term evidence, and it is worth more than the recall number suggests, because a generator reads the top of the list most attentively.
blocks.zh: 对比调谐是ObliQA(0.495 → 0.732 0.495\右侧0.732)上更大的步骤,并巩固了澳大利亚的收益(0.726~0.911 0.726\右侧0.911). 我们将此归因于模式学习,以区分具有类似规范词汇的段落,这是ObliQA中的主要困难. BM25核聚变在ObliQA上增加了最终+0.042+0.042,在澳大利亚数据上增加了+0.012+0.012,对排名质量影响过大:ObliQA,Recall@10升 相对5.7%,而MRR@10上升14.7%,即BM25主要促进密集型号已经检索但排名过低的段落。 这是预期的准确证据的签名,它的价值超过召回数字所显示的,因为一个生成者最认真地阅读了清单的首位。

blocks.en: Table 4: ObliQA retrieval against standard baselines, full validation split (3,733 question–passage pairs, 13,705-passage corpus).
blocks.zh: 表4:Obli 根据标准基线进行QA检索,完全验证分拆(3,733个问题-通过对,13,705个通过单).

blocks.en: Table 4 places the hybrid retriever against standard alternatives on ObliQA. BM25 alone reaches 0.678, within 0.04 Recall@10 of BGE-M3 and BGE-base despite learning nothing about the domain, which underlines the importance of exact terminology in regulatory retrieval. Among dense baselines E5-large-v2 is strongest at 0.758. Our hybrid reaches 0.774 Recall@10 and 0.638 nDCG@10, above every baseline, while its dense component is a BERT-base encoder, roughly a third of E5-large’s parameters, adapted on in-domain data alone. We note that E5-large-v2 attains a marginally higher MRR@10 (0.595 vs. 0.594); the two systems are equivalent on first-hit rank and differ in the depth of the ranking.
blocks.zh: 表4将混合检索器与标准替代品放在ObliQA上。 仅BM25就达到了0.678,在0.04年之内,BGE-M3和BGE-base的Recall@10,尽管对这个领域一无所知,这强调了准确的术语在监管检索中的重要性. 在密集基线中,E5-大v2最强,为0.758. 我们的混合体达到0.774 Recall@10和0.638 nDCG@10, 高于每个基线, 而其密集的成分是BERT-base编码器, 大约是E5大参数的三分之一, 仅根据域内数据改编。 我们注意到,E5大v2的MRR@10(0.595 vs. 0.594)稍高;这两个系统在头重脚轻的级别上相当,排名深度也不同。

blocks.zh: 4.3 关于ObliQA的生成

blocks.zh: 表5报告每个模式和战略的重新考绩制度及其组成部分;图3汇总了两个公司的基础比较与适应比较。 我们关于ObliQA的四项主要结论是:

blocks.zh: 表5:关于ObliQA的答案生成,150个评价问题,混合检索器上下文. 每个模型中最好的再PAS用粗体表示.

blocks.en: 1. Prompting does not generalize across models. Qwen2.5 improves from 0.668 zero-shot to 0.725 with few-shot examples. Teuken degrades ( 0.673 → 0.662 0.673\rightarrow 0.662 ), Gemma-2 degrades further ( 0.594 → 0.565 0.594\rightarrow 0.565 ), and DeepSeek-R1 also loses ground ( 0.735 → 0.702 0.735\rightarrow 0.702 ). Adding chain-of-thought on top of few-shot helps only Gemma-3 ( 0.666 → 0.694 0.666\rightarrow 0.694 ) and DeepSeek-R1 ( 0.702 → 0.713 0.702\rightarrow 0.713 ), and is neutral-to-negative elsewhere. The component columns explain why: for Teuken and Gemma-2 the examples cut obligation coverage sharply (Teuken 0.332 → 0.259 0.332\rightarrow 0.259 , Gemma-2 0.167 → 0.128 0.167\rightarrow 0.128 ) without a compensating drop in contradiction. Our three demonstrations are short, and models with weaker instruction-following imitate their length and shape rather than their reasoning, truncating the exhaustive obligation enumeration that RePASs rewards. This is consistent with evidence that demonstrations mostly convey format [ 65 ] , and it means that few-shot prompting is not a safe default in this domain: it must be validated per model.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 提示并不泛指所有模型。 Quen2.5改进从0.668零射入0.725,少有射入的例子. Teuken的降解(0.673 → 0.662 0.673\右侧0.662),Gemma-2进一步降解(0.594 → 0.565 0.594\右侧0.565),以及DeepSeek-R1也丧失了地力(0.735 → 0.702 0.735\右侧0.702 ),在几发子弹之上添加思维链只会帮助Gemma-3(0.66666 → 0.694 0.66\右侧0.694)和DeepSeek-R1(0.702 → 0.702\右侧0.713),在其他地方是中立的。 组成部分栏解释了为什么:对Teuken和Gemma-2来说,例子大幅度削减了义务的涵盖范围(Teuken 0.332 → 0.259 0.332\右侧0.259,Gemma-2 0.167 → 0.128 0.167\右侧0.128),而没有出现矛盾的补偿性下降。 我们的三次示范是短暂的,而那些在教学上比较弱的模型则模仿其长度和形状,而不是其推理,从而缩短了REPAS奖励的详尽义务列举。 这与示威大多传递格式[65]的证据是一致的,这意味着少数镜头提示不是这个领域的安全默认:每个模型必须验证.

blocks.en: 2. RAFT-LoRA improves every model it can be applied to. Qwen2.5 gains + 0.057 +0.057 (0.668 → \rightarrow 0.725), Teuken + 0.040 +0.040 (0.673 → \rightarrow 0.713), and Gemma-2 + 0.072 +0.072 (0.594 → \rightarrow 0.666). The mechanism is visible in the components and is the same in all three cases: obligation coverage rises substantially (Qwen 0.301 → 0.409 0.301\rightarrow 0.409 , Teuken 0.332 → 0.397 0.332\rightarrow 0.397 , Gemma-2 0.167 → 0.277 0.167\rightarrow 0.277 ) while contradiction falls (Qwen 0.189 → 0.157 0.189\rightarrow 0.157 , Teuken 0.256 → 0.134 0.256\rightarrow 0.134 , Gemma-2 0.317 → 0.212 0.317\rightarrow 0.212 ). This matches the goal of the RAFT objective, namely covering what the context supports without adding unsupported claims. Interestingly, Teuken’s entailment score drops from 0.944 to 0.877 at the same time. Teuken’s base answers are short and closely paraphrase one passage, which scores well on entailment and poorly on coverage; the adapted model writes longer, multi-provision answers in which some sentences are aggregations rather than restatements. For compliance use the adapted behaviour is preferable, and the composite metric agrees, but the raw entailment column would have suggested a regression.
blocks.zh: 2. RAFT-LORA改进了它可以应用的每一种模式。 文2.5增益+0.057+0.057 (0.668 →\右Rightarrow 0.725),泰肯+0.040+0.040 (0.673 →\Rightarrow 0.713),和格玛-2+0.072+0.072 (0.594 →\Rightarrow 0.666)。 该机制在组成部分中可见,在所有三种情况中都是相同的:义务覆盖率大幅度提高(Quen 0.301 – 0.409 0.301\右翼0.409、Teuken 0.332 → 0.397 0.32\右翼0.397、Gemma-2 0.167 → 0.277 0.167\右翼0.277),矛盾下降(Quen 0. 189 → 0.157 0.189\右翼0.157、Teuken 0.256 → 0.34 0.256\右翼0.134、Gemma-2 0.317 → 0.12 0.317\右翼0.212)。 这与RAFT目标的目标相吻合,即涵盖上下文所支持的内容,而不增加无佐证的债权。 有趣的是,Teuken的内涵得分从0.944下降到0.877。 Teuken的基本答案很短,很近地诠释了一段话,这段话的分数很准,而且覆盖面也很差;经过修改的模型写了较长的、多规定的答案,其中有些句子是归纳的,而不是重复的。 就遵守而言,调整后的行为是可取的,综合衡量标准也同意,但原始内涵一栏意味着倒退。

blocks.en: Gemma-2-2B, the smallest model, benefits most from adaptation. In practice, this means that a few hundred training steps of retrieval-aware adaptation can noticeably improve grounding in a 2B model.
blocks.zh: Gemma-2-2B,最小的模型,从适应中受益最大. 在实践中,这意味着几百个培训步骤的检索-意识适应可明显改善2B模式的基础。

blocks.en: 3. Adaptation is not universally available. Two of the five models could not be adapted. Merging LoRA adapters into DeepSeek-R1-Distill produced inconsistent generation at inference, and Gemma-3 showed near-zero loss movement across epochs, indicating that the target sequence was recoverable from the input and no useful gradient signal was present. We exclude both models from the comparison. For deployment, however, this shows that LoRA adaptation and adapter merging do not work equally reliably across architectures.
blocks.zh: 3个 适应并不普遍。 5种模式中的2种无法适应. 将LORA适配器合并到DeepSeek-R1-Distill中,在推论中生成了不一致的生成,Gemma-3表现出了近零损失的跨纪运动,表明目标序列可以从输入中恢复,并且没有出现有用的梯度信号. 我们把这两个模型排除在比较之外。 然而,就部署而言,这表明,LORA的适应和适配器的合并在各种架构之间并不同样可靠。

blocks.en: 4. The strongest single ObliQA number belongs to an unadapted model. DeepSeek-R1-Distill reaches 0.735 zero-shot, above every RAFT-LoRA result. Its profile is unlike the others: obligation coverage 0.877, far higher than any other system, with entailment of only 0.693 and contradiction of 0.365. A reasoning-distilled model enumerates context obligations exhaustively, which RePASs rewards twice: directly through O ​ C s OC_{s} , and indirectly because long enumerations dilute the per-sentence contradiction average. Its lower entailment, meanwhile, shows that much of what it writes is not directly supported by any single passage. The composite score cannot tell whether these answers are more useful for compliance than Qwen’s more conservative ones.
blocks.zh: 4个 最强单曲ObliQA数字属于未适应型号. DeepSeek-R1-Distill达到0.735零发,高于RAFT-LORA的每个结果. 它的特征与其他特征不同:义务涵盖范围为0.877,远远高于任何其他系统,只涉及0.693,矛盾为0.365。 一个推理分散的模式详尽地列举了上下文义务,RepAS奖励两次:直接通过OC S OC_{s},间接地因为长时间的列举淡化了平均判决率的矛盾。 同时,它的低层次含义表明,它所写的很多内容并没有直接得到任何单一段落的支持。 综合得分无法分辨出这些答案是否比Quen更保守的答案更有助于遵守.

blocks.en: 4.4 Cross-Domain Transfer
blocks.zh: 4.4 跨领域转让

blocks.en: The Australian results in Table 6 serve two purposes: they test whether the retriever and prompting conclusions hold on a different legal genre, and they test whether the ObliQA-trained adapters transfer. The adapters are reused unchanged; no Australian RAFT data was generated.
blocks.zh: 澳大利亚在表6中的结果有两个目的:它们检验检索器和催化结论是否具有不同的法律流派,它们检验ObliQA训练的适配器是否转移. 适配器未变复用;没有生成澳大利亚RAFT数据.

blocks.en: Table 6: Answer generation on Open Australian LegalQA, 150 evaluation questions. † marks adapters trained on ObliQA and applied without retraining.
blocks.zh: 表6:关于开放澳大利亚法律质量保证的答案生成,150个评价问题。 • 标记适配器在ObliQA上接受训练,不经过再培训就应用。

blocks.en: The findings on prompting are even clearer here: zero-shot is the best prompted strategy for Qwen, Teuken, Gemma-2, and Gemma-3, and few-shot and chain-of-thought degrade every one of them. Only DeepSeek-R1 prefers chain-of-thought (0.613), again through obligation coverage.
blocks.zh: 对Quen、Teuken、Gemma-2和Gemma-3来说, 只有DeepSeek-R1更喜欢思想链(0.613),再次通过义务覆盖.

blocks.en: The adapters, however, mostly do not transfer. Qwen drops from 0.642 to 0.581 and Gemma-2 from 0.477 to 0.453; only Teuken improves, 0.559 to 0.586. The component scores show why: Gemma-2’s obligation coverage collapses to 0.013, because the adapted model reproduces the terse rulebook-style answer it was trained to produce, which covers almost nothing in a long case-law passage. Qwen’s coverage falls from 0.377 to 0.238 for the same reason. Teuken is the exception because its adaptation gain came predominantly from contradiction reduction ( 0.552 → 0.463 0.552\rightarrow 0.463 ), and learning not to assert unsupported claims is a genre-independent behaviour, whereas learning the shape of an ADGM obligation answer is not.
blocks.zh: 然而,适配器大多不进行转让。 Quen从0.642降至0.581,Gemma-2从0.477降至0.453;只有Teuken改进,0.559降至0.586. Gemma-2的债务覆盖率跌至0.013, 因为改编的模型重现了它训练出来的三角规则书式的答案, 由于同样的原因,Quen的覆盖率从0.377降至0.238。 Teuken是例外,因为它的适应收益主要来自矛盾的减少(0.552–0.463 0.552\rightarrow 0.463),学会不主张无根据的债权是一种流派独立行为,而学习ADGM义务答案的形状则不是.

blocks.en: We attribute this to two structural differences between the corpora. ObliQA passages are short numbered provisions with an explicit normative operator, and the mapping from retrieved passage to answer is close to deterministic. Australian passages are extended excerpts of judicial reasoning in which the answer is distributed across the passage and rarely stated as an obligation at all. Contradiction scores are also consistently higher on the Australian data: every model contradicts its context far more often on Australian data (0.40–0.68) than on ObliQA (0.13–0.37), even though retrieval is much better there (Recall@10 0.923 vs. 0.774). Long argumentative passages contain positions the court ultimately rejects, and an NLI model scoring a summary against every sentence of such a passage will find contradictions that are not errors. This is a limitation of sentence-level NLI metrics on case law, and it means Table 6 should be read within-column rather than against Table 5 .
blocks.zh: 我们将此归因于公司之间的两个结构差异. ObliQA段落是带有明确规范操作者的短号条款,从检索通道到回答的绘图接近确定性. 澳大利亚的段落是司法推理的扩展节选,其答案在整个段落中分布,很少被说成是一项义务。 在澳大利亚数据上,矛盾分数也一直较高:在澳大利亚数据(0.40-0.68)上,每个模型与上下文相矛盾的频率远高于ObliQA(0.13-0.37),尽管那里的检索要好得多(Recall@10 0.923 vs. 0.774)。 冗长的争论段落包含了法院最终拒绝的立场,一个NLI模型对这样一个段落的每一句都给出一个总结,将会发现不是错误的矛盾. 这是对判例法中判刑一级NLI指标的限制,这意味着表6应在栏内而不是对照表5阅读。

blocks.en: The practical implication is that RAFT-LoRA adapters are corpus-specific artifacts. A firm deploying this pipeline across several regulatory regimes should expect to build RAFT data per regime rather than to reuse one adapter.
blocks.zh: 其实际含义是RAFT-LORA适配器是特制文物. 一家通过若干管理制度部署这一管道的公司应当期望建立每个管理制度的RAFT数据,而不是重新使用一个适配器。

blocks.en: 4.5 Is Retrieval Doing the Work?
blocks.zh: 4.5 检索工作?

blocks.en: To check that the retrieval pipeline is responsible for the answer quality we measure, we ran Qwen2.5 and Teuken closed-book: same prompt, same questions, no passages. RePASs is still computed against the retrieved passages the model never saw. These runs cover 132 and 89 validation questions respectively rather than the full 150, so they are indicative rather than precise; the effect below is far larger than that sample difference can explain.
blocks.zh: 为了检查检索管道是否负责我们测量的答案质量,我们运行了Quen2.5和Teuken闭页:同样的即时,同样的问题,没有通道. RePAS仍然根据模型从未见过的检索段落计算。 这些问题分别涵盖132个和89个验证问题,而不是全部的150个,因此它们只是指示性的,而不是精确的;下文的影响远远大于样本差异可以解释的.

blocks.en: Table 7: Closed-book control on ObliQA. Scores are computed against retrieved passages that the closed-book models did not receive. Closed-book runs cover 132 (Qwen) and 89 (Teuken) validation questions.
blocks.zh: 表7:ObliQA的封闭式账簿控制。 分数是根据已取回的闭页模型没有收到的段落计算的。 闭帐式运行覆盖132(Quen)和89(Teuken)验证问题.

blocks.en: Table 7 shows the results. Closed-book Qwen scores 0.657 compared to 0.668 with retrieval, and closed-book Teuken 0.662 compared to 0.673. A difference of about 0.01 clearly understates the gap between an answer grounded in the ADGM rulebook and one generated from parametric knowledge alone. Inspection of the closed-book outputs confirms that they are plausible-sounding regulatory prose that misstates obligations, omits binding conditions, and cites nothing.
blocks.zh: 表7显示结果。 闭账本Quen的得分为0.657分,而检索的得分为0.668分,闭账本Teuken的得分为0.662分,而0.673分. 大约0.01的差别明显低估了基于ADGM规则手册的答案与仅从参数化知识中得出的答案之间的差距。 对封闭式账面产出的检查证实,这些产出是令人信服的监管假说,错误地陈述了义务,省去了约束性条件,并且不提任何内容。

blocks.en: The components show how the score is obtained. Closed-book contradiction is very low (0.081 and 0.096, against 0.189 and 0.256 with retrieval), because an answer that never commits to a specific provision has little to contradict; and E s E_{s} takes a maximum over passage sentences, so generic regulatory statements find some sentence that entails them. Obligation coverage does fall as expected (Qwen 0.301 → 0.169 0.301\rightarrow 0.169 ), but it is one of three terms in Equation ( 9 ) and the contradiction reduction offsets most of it.
blocks.zh: 组件显示分数是如何获得的. 封闭式书本矛盾非常低(0.081和0.096,对应0.189和0.256有检索),因为一个从未承诺过某项具体条款的答案几乎没有矛盾之处;以及Es E_{s}在通过句子上取最大,所以通用的监管语句会找到一些引起这些内容的句子. 义务的涵盖范围确实如预期的那样缩小(Quen 0.301 — 0.169 0.301\ 右侧0.169),但它是方程式(9)的三个术语之一,矛盾的减少抵消了大部分。

blocks.en: We draw two conclusions from this. First, RePASs should not be used on its own to rank regulatory QA systems, and results should be reported together with a closed-book baseline. Second, the main benefit of retrieval in our setting is attributability, i.e., the ability to trace an answer back to a specific provision. Compliance applications require this property, but RePASs does not capture it. Of its three components, only obligation coverage clearly separates the retrieval and closed-book settings.
blocks.zh: 我们从中得出两个结论。 第一,不应自行使用重新考绩制度来对监管质量保证系统进行排序,结果应与封闭账本基线一并报告。 第二,在我们的环境下检索的主要好处是可归属性,即能够追溯到某一具体条款的答案。 合规应用程序需要这种属性,但RePAS没有捕获它. 在其三个组成部分中,只有义务范围明确区分了检索和封闭账簿设置。

blocks.en: 4.6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 4.6 限制

blocks.en: Several constraints bound these results. Generation is scored on 150 questions per configuration, and the closed-book control on fewer still; differences of a few thousandths of RePASs, such as Qwen’s tie between few-shot and RAFT-LoRA, are within noise, and we make no claims at that resolution. The leakage-free re-split discards 989 multi-passage question–passage pairs, tilting ObliQA toward single-passage questions and away from the multi-provision reasoning that real compliance work demands. RePASs, as Section 4.5 shows, is not a sufficient measure of grounding; an attribution-sensitive metric or an LLM-as-judge protocol [ 66 ] would be a better instrument, and human expert evaluation better still. Finally, the two corpora studied here are both English and both drawn from public sources; internal policy documents, tabular disclosures, and multilingual rulebooks remain untested.
blocks.zh: 这些结果受到若干制约。 一代人每组150个问题都得分,对更少的封闭式账本控制;数千个RPAS的区别,如Quen在几发和RAFT-LORA之间的领带,都在噪音中,我们对该决议没有提出任何主张。 无渗漏的重分解抛弃了989个多通道问题 — — 通道对对,将ObliQA向单通道问题倾斜,并远离真正合规工作要求的多条款推理。 如第4.5节所示,退职考绩制度不是衡量理由的充分尺度;对归属问题敏感的衡量标准或LLM即时裁判规程[66]将是一个更好的工具,而人类专家评价则更好。 最后,在这里研究的两家公司既是英文,也是来自公共来源;内部政策文件、表格披露和多语种规则书仍未经过检验。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We investigated how much of the gap between compact language models and reliable regulatory question answering can be closed by adapting the pipeline instead of scaling the model. The retrieval half of that gap closes substantially and is directly measured: a LegalBERT encoder that ranks the correct Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) provision among its top ten for one query in four does so for three queries in four after entailment tuning, contrastive tuning, and BM25 fusion, ahead of E5-large-v2 at a fraction of the parameters. The generation half improves on the metric available to us, in that retrieval-aware LoRA adaptation raises composite RePASs for every compact generator we could adapt, most for the smallest, by increasing obligation coverage and reducing contradictions on a few hundred teacher-labelled examples. We describe this as improved in-domain answer behaviour rather than as improved grounding, because our closed-book control shows that RePASs does not distinguish the two.
blocks.zh: 我们调查了在紧凑的语言模式与可靠的监管问题答案之间有多大的差距可以通过调整管道而不是扩大模型来弥补。 其中一半的检索大大缩小了差距,并直接进行了测量:一个法律BERT编码器将正确的阿布扎比全球市场(ADGM)规定排在其前十位,用于四分之一的查询,对于四分之三的查询,在引入调值、对比调值和BM25核聚变之后,在参数的一小部分领先于E5-大v2。 一代人的一半改进了我们可以利用的衡量标准,因为回收-认识LORA的适应性为我们能够适应的每一个紧凑的发电机都提供了复合的RePAS,其中多数是最小的,方法是增加义务覆盖面,减少几百个教师标榜的例子上的矛盾。 我们将此描述为改进了域内回答行为,而不是改进了基础,因为我们的封闭账本控制显示,RePAS没有区分两者.

blocks.en: Three conclusions are supported by these experiments. First, domain-adapted retrieval is effective: staged adaptation of a small in-domain encoder outperforms both a strong lexical baseline and larger general-purpose dense encoders on regulatory text. Second, RAFT-LoRA improves compact generators in-domain, and in-domain only: adapters trained on ADGM rulebook data lost most of their benefit on Australian case law, so deployments spanning several regulatory regimes should plan for regime-specific RAFT data rather than adapter reuse. Third, current evaluation metrics can substantially understate the value of retrieval. A closed-book model that received no passages, cited nothing, and misstated obligations scored within 0.011 RePASs of the full pipeline, so RePASs cannot on its own validate a compliance system. Therefore, Retrieval remains essential for transparency and traceability, but regulatory NLP needs evaluation protocols that can measure these properties.
blocks.zh: 这些实验支持三项结论。 首先,域调适检索是有效的:一个小型域内编码器的分阶段调整,既超越了强大的词汇基线,也超越了监管文本上更大的通用密集编码器. 第二,RAFT-LORA改进了田内紧凑的发电机,而且只改进了田内紧凑的发电机:接受过ADGM规则手册数据培训的适配器丧失了在澳大利亚判例法上的大部分好处,因此,跨越多个管理制度的部署应当为针对制度的RAFT数据制定计划,而不是适应器再利用。 第三,目前的评价指标可能大大低估检索的价值。 封闭式账本模式没有收到任何段落,没有引用任何内容,而且错报的债务在全编审过程中的0.011重新考绩制度内得分,因此重新考绩制度本身无法验证遵守制度。 因此,检索对于透明度和可追踪性仍然至关重要,但监管NLP需要能够测量这些属性的评价协议.
